agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Bounded adoption posture (adopt, bounded experiment, proof of concept, monitor, defer, reject) for this application in this organization now

analytical_question: What single current adoption action should this organization take for agentic chart review, and what evidence or changed condition would justify a different action? Distinguish advice from execution authority.
general_et_finding: Course classification for this application class: an exact market class is unresolved from the common finance evidence; the unvalidated chart use warrants provisional bleeding-edge caution. The source candidate requests an application-class reading in this field. Admissions benchmarks, prices and legal claims do not establish finance-chart maturity; posture must not reclassify it.
application_finding: Read-only chart-to-table review could improve source-linked correction drafts, but baseline technical feasibility, task reliability and net advantage are unproved. Treat this unvalidated application cautiously, closer to bleeding-edge characteristics for broad rollout, without inventing a measured diffusion stage. Manual analyst review and adequate deterministic checks are real alternatives. Judge accepted correctness, material misses, false corrections, lineage and complete effort, not fast drafting alone.
organization_specific_finding: Recommendation: MONITOR | Decisive factor: conservative evidence preference despite K1 permission | Posture: conservative. K1 supplies limited isolated learning permission, replacing the baseline blocker. The conservative preference still favors matched peer and baseline evidence before spending that allowance. Monitoring is a revisable choice, not a claim that safe learning is prohibited.

evidence.evidence_type: Vendor engineering experience, not a comparative finance study

evidence.claim: Use empirical, contextual capability checks and source verification; narrow anecdotal demonstrations do not establish broader performance.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Teaching-case premises are not actual permissions or measured outcomes. K1/H1-H3 are fictional controls.
The saved examples and comparison walkthroughs are same-assistant reasoning, not independent model repeats or a company pilot.
No current chart-task peer denominator, vendor/model qualification, negotiated cost or legal clearance is supplied for the baseline. Prior student outputs are not independent external corroboration.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that case permissions bind; moderate confidence in the scoped dated evidence; low confidence in baseline local performance, full cost and diffusion stage. No numerical reliability estimate follows from saved-example checks.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential source traceability and faster review must beat the best adequate baseline at equivalent quality after review, correction, failures, setup and support. Prices and local financial ROI remain unknown.
risk_governance_implication: No sensitive-data upload, production integration, autonomous publication or financial/customer decision is allowed by the baseline. Human oversight and action-specific permission remain necessary in every case. Stop on unauthorized access, lost source lineage, material unsupported correction, escaped shadow output, lost oversight or cap exhaustion; revert to manual/deterministic review. Organizational Adoption must assess sustainable readiness; this agent cannot certify it.
recommendation_management_implication: MONITOR — collect matched chart-use and baseline evidence without starting agent use, with the reporting manager reviewing within four weeks. K1 permits a public/synthetic PoC but conservative evidence preference does not yet justify its effort. The nearest alternative is that capped PoC; switch if a valuable technical question and information value justify learning. A later internal workflow needs separate permission.
change_monitoring_triggers: Permission: a specifically documented data/environment/project authorization can remove deferral for that scope only.
Feasibility: reproducible source-linked behavior within approved controls can justify considering a comparative experiment.

Value: representative repeated advantage over the best adequate baseline, with acceptable severity/misses and complete effort, can justify the next scoped review; adverse results favor the simpler option.
Maturity/peer evidence: dated matched application evidence can update uncertainty, never waive local controls or establish a 16% shortcut.
Cost, terms and capability: changed prospective support, model/version, vendor/data terms or incident may require pausing and renewed qualification.
Readiness: request a separate Organizational Adoption finding on staffing, budget, training, governance and sustained support before operating release.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Outside any explicit fictional case evidence, obtain exact task qualification, complete comparator costs and case-specific permission rather than infer them.
Proposed owners must approve materiality, error tolerances, task breadth and any learning budget before actual execution.
No legal compliance, real organizational readiness, actual company savings or universal diffusion stage is certified.
